'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Brian Herold LS Center Of Tyranny''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Illustrated joke sheet ('''Center Of Irony'''; Project Mayhem 2011); dest [[Center Of Tyranny]] / [[Brian Herold]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Center Of Tyranny]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
